same_support.definition: distance=4 and all four target-lattice combinations component-valid

system_cost.reuse: image-level proposals and component checks are reused across all distances and candidate orders; four recombinations and candidate matching are deterministic and require no additional VLM calls

continuous.formula: candidate separation in ticks / (cross-hypothesis prediction MAD in ticks + 0.5), after component-valid >=3-way candidate agreement

selected_rule.selection_rule: maximum Existing69 coverage subject to >=0.95 candidate precision among nine predefined invariance-by-distance rules

k3_subset_extension.scope: post-hoc exploratory extension on a prior-consensus-preselected 36-image K3 subset

evidence_boundary.analysis_status: descriptive robustness reanalysis of frozen Paired128 outputs

major_family_robustness.suggested_headline: The three-model majority Physicalization gain remains positive after removing each major instrument family; all major-family LOFO bootstrap intervals exclude zero.

family_robustness.scope: Paired128 three-model majority Physicalized minus Numeric, with image-balanced leave-one-family-out analysis

main_effect_sensitivity.criterion: exclude the two audited images with target disagreement greater than one local tick

evidence_boundary.resampling_unit: source image with all six distance/sign cells retained

original_selected_rule.selection_rule: maximum Existing69 coverage subject to >=0.95 candidate precision among nine predefined invariance-by-distance rules

selection_stability.selection_objective: maximum Existing69 coverage subject to >=0.95 candidate precision among nine predefined invariance-by-distance rules
